title: SelfHostedWorkListResponse
description: Response when listing work items with cursor-based pagination.

next_page.title: Next Page
next_page.description: Opaque cursor for fetching the next page of results

acknowledged_at.title: Acknowledged At
acknowledged_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the work item was acknowledged and assigned to a self-hosted sandbox

created_at.title: Created At
created_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when work was created

data.description: The actual work to be performed

environment_id.title: Environment Id
environment_id.description: Environment identifier this work belongs to (e.g., `env_...`)

latest_heartbeat_at.title: Latest Heartbeat At
latest_heartbeat_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the most recent heartbeat

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: User-provided metadata key-value pairs associated with this work item

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Credential payload used by the environment worker to execute this work item. May be populated when polling for work; null on all other retrieval paths.

started_at.title: Started At
started_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when work execution started

state.title: State
state.description: Current state of the work item

stop_requested_at.title: Stop Requested At
stop_requested_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when stop was requested

stopped_at.title: Stopped At
stopped_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when work execution stopped

BetaSelfHostedWork.title: SelfHostedWork
BetaSelfHostedWork.description:
Work resource representing a unit of work in a self-hosted environment.

Work items are queued when sessions are created or when long-dormant sessions
receive new messages. The environment worker polls for work to execute in a
self-hosted sandbox.

BetaSessionWorkData.title: SessionWorkData
BetaSessionWorkData.description:
Work data for session work items.

This resource type is used when work represents a session that needs to be executed
in a self-hosted environment.
